limits: Creation tags differ by one second and are not a separately instrumented wall-clock-to-PTS synchronization. Correspondence with the correct tab tap supports, but does not calibrate, visual timing.
The adjacent-frame visual transition does not measure tap-to-render latency.
Sparse variable-frame-rate recording can retain an unchanged visual frame; a gap does not by itself prove a JS freeze, dropped display frames, or uninterrupted healthy JS execution.
The recording shows pixels, not the accessibility hierarchy used by a failed lookup.
